:::{#exm-new-observation}
#### A new observation for the first five cars

Take the first five cars of `mtcars` as the [training set](#def-training-set),
with the gross horsepower `hp` and weight `wt` as the covariate values and the fuel economy `mpg` as the outcome,
as in @exm-input-matrix.
Any other car in the data is a new observation, because it is not in the training set.
Take the sixth car:

```{r}
#| label: new-observation-mtcars
#| code-fold: false

# the sixth car is not among the five training cars
new_car <- mtcars |>
  dplyr::slice(6) |>
  dplyr::select(hp, wt, mpg)
new_car
```

Its covariate value is $\newpredvar = (`r new_car$hp`, `r new_car$wt`)$ and its outcome is $\newoutvar = `r new_car$mpg`$.

:::
